players.product: Data-center cooling (Airedale chillers/CRAHs, liquid cooling) — pure-play after PT spin

quarterly_data.signal: Modine's first quarter fiscal 2027 release reports Data Centers segment sales of $348.6 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared with $183.7 million one year ago, primarily driven by higher sales to hyperscale customers in North America. The segment's gross margin was 20.2 percent, 960 basis points lower than the prior year, and its adjusted EBITDA was $51.7 million. CEO Neil Brinker said three consecutive quarters of record order intake have led the backlog to nearly double over the past year.
quarterly_data.figure: Data Centers sales $348.6 million (vs $183.7 million); gross margin 20.2 percent; adjusted EBITDA $51.7 million; backlog nearly doubled over the past year
